title: Artisan HUD
description: A HUD is what stays drawn on the players' screens in one overlay slot: images and texts laid out in pixels, the texts Templates that read the player and the Variables. Permanent, conditional (`when`) or temporary (`enabled: false`, shown by `show_hud`). File `huds/<id>.yml`; the id is the file name. Drawn only for a player whose client has the resource pack (never a Bedrock player).

enabled.description: false: drawn only while a `show_hud` lasts (a temporary HUD).

slot.description: Where it is drawn: under the top of the screen (`boss_bar`) or above the action bar. The HUDs of one slot stack by `priority`.

priority.description: Order in its slot: the highest is drawn on top. Equal priorities in the order they first showed.

refresh.description: Ticks between two checks of its conditions and texts: 0 (on a change of Variable, join, pack loaded, show_hud, reload only) or 5 to 1200. A value out of range is brought within it and reported. A change of Variable updates it at once whatever this value.

when.description: Conditions, all required, checked for the player at each check: the HUD is drawn while they hold.

layout.description: The layers, drawn in this order, x and y in GUI pixels from the slot's origin (x from the centre of the screen). `list` and `image_slot` layers are filled by a module's code: a HUD leaves them out and reports them.

texts.description: The MiniMessage of each text layer, by its name. `{…}` values (`{player}`, `{var.coins}`) are drawn as text, never read as markup; `%papi%` placeholders are resolved as in menus. A line break or `<newline>` starts a row; each row is wrapped to the layer's width and cut at its `lines`.

notes.description: The author's notes, never read by the server.

text.description: Its name, the key of its text in `texts`.
